scope: Actual production Tiptap editor; non-sensitive short/long documents, real browser typing/selection/scroll and IndexedDB, isolated API persistence/session endpoints. Not a live Supabase/provider or physical-device test.

scenarios.name: Short document selection, cursor, stable text/view and enter/exit
Typing during transition: all characters saved, five legitimate words, same active session
Long document at middle: selection/scroll stable throughout every frame
Paused session: enter/exit preserves content and selection
Paused typing saved without adding session words/time or restarting the session
Active session: Focus never pauses, ends or duplicates activity
Active time stays within wall-clock tolerance; no duplicate or misattributed sessions
Sidebars fade and become inert; original open state restored without AI requests
Responsive selection/position 1440px
Responsive selection/position 1024px
Responsive selection/position 768px
Responsive selection/position 390px
Responsive selection/position 320px
Keyboard Enter/Escape, persistent save/session controls and WCAG checks at five widths
Dark theme selection and position
Touch activation, IME Escape, dark mode and Spanish focus controls
Reduced motion: selection, content, session and scroll preserved
Reduced motion at activation and preference change during transition
Intentional scrolling and rapid reversals remain under writer control
Failed save never shown as saved; retry persists the intact draft
Offline local save, reconnect, full reload/persistence, unchanged sessions and no AI calls
